mechanism: Diltiazem inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes levonorgestrel, potentially increasing levonorgestrel concentrations and contraceptive efficacy while increasing risk of adverse effects.
action: Monitor for levonorgestrel-related adverse effects (nausea, breast tenderness, headache); consider alternative contraception or additional barrier methods; counsel patient on reduced efficacy risk if diltiazem induces metabolism unpredictably.
